case_title: DJERNAES, CHRISTINA A. VS KNYPER, LEONARD et al

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $300.00 FILED BY DJERNAES, CHRISTINA A. AS TO DEFENDANT KNYPER, LEONARD KNYPER MARJORIE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-26-1994 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 07
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL
CERTIFIED MAIL TO LEONARD KNYPER RETURNED SIGNED.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF DJERNAES, CHRISTINA A. RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT KNYPER, LEONARD KNYPER MARJORIE $95.86 PRINCIPAL, $20.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $115.86, MARJORIE KNYPER VOLUNTARILY SUBMITTED TO THE COURT JURISDDICTION EVEN THOUGH SHE WAS NOT SERVED STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
